g.title: RoyalMail_Case14326119
g.text: Royal Mail Case #14326119 — Deflection Pattern & Escalation Map

g.title: Deflection
g.text: avoid escalation → avoid investigation → redirect responsibility → close case

g.title: Escalation_1
g.text: confirm whether the SMS messages were genuine
remove your number from any notification system
block your number from future alerts
escalate to the Fraud & Cyber Security Team
acknowledge the repeated pattern over 9 months
address the possibility of a miss-linked Royal Mail account
address the possibility of systemic error
the “minimum viable reply” that closes the ticket unless you push back.
